intro: Vienna rewards visitors with grand palaces, world-class museums, and a relaxed café culture. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: U-Bahn, trams, and buses run on one ticket; buy a 24/48/72-hour pass or single fares around €2.60.
Validate tickets before riding; inspectors fine on the spot.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Bolt both work in Vienna.
Driving is slow and parking is scarce; skip the rental car in town.
The centre is flat and walkable; bikes and e-scooters are easy to rent.
No ferries; the Danube is crossed by bridges and the U-Bahn.

schonbrunn.name: Schönbrunn Palace
schonbrunn.price_text: ≈ EUR 25–35 for the Grand Tour; gardens free
schonbrunn.hours: Daily roughly 08:30–17:00, longer in summer; check on the day
schonbrunn.tip: Book a timed ticket online and arrive early; the gardens and Gloriette hill are free.

hofburg.name: Hofburg Palace
hofburg.price_text: ≈ EUR 18–25 for the Imperial Apartments, Sisi Museum and Silver Collection
hofburg.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:30; check on the day
hofburg.tip: The combined ticket covers the apartments, Sisi Museum and silver collection in one loop.

stephansdom.name: St Stephen's Cathedral
stephansdom.price_text: Nave free; towers and catacombs ≈ EUR 6–15 each
stephansdom.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 09:00–17:00, Sun from 13:00; check on the day
stephansdom.tip: Climb the south tower stairs for the roof tiles, or take the lift up the north tower.

belvedere.name: Belvedere Palace
belvedere.price_text: ≈ EUR 15–20 for Upper Belvedere; gardens free
belvedere.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–18:00; check on the day
belvedere.tip: Upper Belvedere holds Klimt's 'The Kiss'; book online and walk the free gardens between the palaces.

staatsoper.name: Vienna State Opera
staatsoper.price_text: Standing tickets ≈ EUR 10–20; seated tickets much higher
staatsoper.hours: Box office daily; performances usually evening
staatsoper.tip: Cheap standing places go on sale shortly before the show; queue early.

kunsthistorisches.name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
kunsthistorisches.hours: Closed Monday · Tue–Sun roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
kunsthistorisches.tip: See the Bruegel collection and the painted staircase, then rest in the café under the dome.

mq.name: MuseumsQuartier
mq.tip: Grab a drink on the Enzi furniture in the courtyard and watch the city go by.

naschmarkt.name: Naschmarkt
naschmarkt.price_text: Free to browse; food and drinks priced per stall
naschmarkt.hours: Mon–Fri roughly 06:00–21:00, Sat until about 18:00; closed Sunday
naschmarkt.tip: Come hungry on Saturday morning for the flea market at the far end.

albertina.name: Albertina
albertina.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00, later some evenings; check on the day
albertina.tip: The state rooms and the view from the terrace are worth the ticket alone.

nationalbibliothek.name: Austrian National Library
nationalbibliothek.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
nationalbibliothek.tip: The baroque State Hall is the highlight; go early for quiet photos.

burgtheater.name: Burgtheater
burgtheater.price_text: Tickets vary widely; guided tours ≈ EUR 10–15
burgtheater.hours: Box office daily; performances usually evening
burgtheater.tip: If you don't speak German, take a daytime guided tour of the building instead.

danube_cruise.name: Danube Canal Cruise
danube_cruise.price_text: ≈ EUR 20–30 for a short city boat tour
danube_cruise.hours: Seasonal, roughly April–October; check on the day
danube_cruise.tip: Sit outside at the back for the best views of the canal graffiti and bridges.

happel.name: Ernst-Happel-Stadion
happel.price_text: Stadium tours ≈ EUR 10–15; match tickets vary
happel.hours: Tours on selected days; check on the day
happel.tip: Only worth the trip for football fans or a match day; check the tour schedule first.

haus_der_musik.name: Haus der Musik
haus_der_musik.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–22:00; check on the day
haus_der_musik.tip: Good for families and rainy days; the virtual conductor is the fun part.

heiligenkreuz.name: Heiligenkreuz Abbey
heiligenkreuz.price_text: ≈ EUR 8–12 for a guided tour; church free
heiligenkreuz.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00; tours at set times
heiligenkreuz.tip: It is outside the city in the Vienna Woods; combine with a day trip by train or car.

hundertwasser.name: Hundertwasserhaus
hundertwasser.tip: It is a private apartment block, so admire it from the street and skip the doorway.

kaisergruft.name: Kaisergruft
kaisergruft.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
kaisergruft.tip: The Habsburg crypt sits under the Kapuzinerkirche; the plain coffins are surprisingly moving.

kapuzinerkirche.name: Kapuzinerkirche
kapuzinerkirche.tip: Step in for a quiet moment before or after the crypt next door.

leopold.name: Leopold Museum
leopold.hours: Closed Tuesday · Wed–Sun roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
leopold.tip: The Schiele and Klimt collection is the draw; allow two hours.

liechtenstein.name: Liechtenstein City Palace
liechtenstein.hours: Limited tour times; check on the day
liechtenstein.tip: Tours are limited, so book ahead; the baroque rooms are the highlight.

mariahilfer.name: Mariahilfer Strasse
mariahilfer.price_text: Free to walk; shops priced per item
mariahilfer.tip: It is the main shopping street; go on a weekday to avoid Saturday crowds.

mozarthaus.name: Mozarthaus Vienna
mozarthaus.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
mozarthaus.tip: Small museum in Mozart's only surviving Vienna apartment; good for music fans.

kahlenberg.name: Kahlenberg viewpoint
kahlenberg.price_text: Free; bus or taxi to get there
kahlenberg.tip: Best city panorama over the Danube; take bus 38A from Heiligenstadt.

prater.name: Prater and Riesenrad
prater.hours: Wheel daily roughly 10:00–22:00; park always open
prater.tip: Ride the old Ferris wheel at dusk for city lights, then walk the chestnut avenue.

cafe_central.name: Café Central
cafe_central.tip: Classic Viennese coffee house; expect a queue, or go mid-afternoon.

donauinsel.name: Danube Island walk
donauinsel.tip: Locals swim and cycle here in summer; bring a picnic and rent a bike.

spittelberg.name: Spittelberg neighbourhood walk
spittelberg.hours: Always open; bars busiest in the evening
spittelberg.tip: Quiet cobbled lanes with small bars and shops; combine with the MuseumsQuartier.

third_man_tour.name: Third Man film locations walk
third_man_tour.price_text: ≈ EUR 10–20 for a guided walk; check operators
third_man_tour.hours: Scheduled tours; check on the day
third_man_tour.tip: Fun for film fans; the sewer scenes were shot near the canal in the Innere Stadt.

stays.why: Walk to St. Stephen's, the Hofburg and the Ringstrasse. Quietest at night; book early.
Across the Danube canal, near the Prater and the Augarten. Good U-Bahn links, better value.
Between the MuseumsQuartier and the Naschmarkt. Lively streets, easy walk to the centre.
Independent shops, bars and cafés. Young feel, 10–15 minutes on the U-Bahn to the centre.

food: Try a Wiener Schnitzel (veal or pork) with potato salad, and Tafelspitz (boiled beef) in a traditional Beisl.
Coffee houses are a ritual: order a Melange, sit long, and read the papers. Cake like Sachertorte or Apfelstrudel is normal mid-afternoon.
Naschmarkt on Saturday morning: stalls, spices and cheap snacks. Many stands close on Sunday.
Street food: a Käsekrainer sausage from a Würstelstand, around €5–7.
Book dinner ahead for popular places; many kitchens close around 22:00. Tipping is rounding up plus a little, said aloud.
more_time: Swap a museum morning for Schönbrunn Palace and its gardens, half a day with the U4.
Take a day trip to the Wachau valley or Baden by train; check times on the day.
Add a Danube evening: swim or walk at the Alte Donau, or cycle the Donauinsel.
